title: MA61048: Generalized Convexity And Variational
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Functional Analysis, Linear AlgebraGeometric form of Hahn Banach
theorem, convex sets and cones in normed linear spaces, convex functionals,
conjugate convex functionals, subdifferential, quasi and pseudo and other
generalized convex functionals and their properties. Optimality and duality in
normed linear spaces. Monotone operators, variational inequality,
complementarity problem, equilibrium problem
